properties.notes: Vacant land area and areas of hard standing adjacent to a freight-only railway line. Previously the site of agricultural buildings but these clearance has now taken place and the site is available for redevelopment. An application for clearance and redevelopment for 15 dwellings is now in place (12/01397/FUL), Completion is expected for 2022/23. A previous application for erection of 11 houses was withdrawn (09/E/00503/FUL).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
